title: Lead Content
jobDescription: Job Description – Lead Content Developer (Content and Facilitation) About the Role The Lead Content Developer will be responsible for the creation, development, and oversight of engaging and effective learning materials tailored for audiences at various leadership levels. This role demands creativity, a passion for training, strong attention to detail, and leadership skills. Additionally, the Lead Content Developer will mentor junior team members and stay abreast of industry trends and emerging tools and technologies to continuously improve content development processes. 1. Stakeholder Analysis Conduct and lead stakeholder conversations to comprehend client needs, challenges, and requirements. Develop comprehensive stakeholder analysis reports and obtain client sign-off. Gain a deep understanding of assigned projects and client needs to ensure alignment with organizational goals. 2. Content Design, Development, and Maintenance Understand complex business problem statements, learner profiles, and advanced evaluation methodologies to design effective learning solutions. Apply advanced adult learning principles in content development. Utilize various techniques and methodologies to create training content that addresses different learning styles. Develop sophisticated training collaterals such as quizzes, assessments, reading materials, case studies, exercises, and activities tailored for higher-level leadership. Conduct extensive research to contextualize content to the client's industry needs and challenges. Leverage Generative AI and AI-powered research tools to accelerate content research, ideation, and content development while ensuring accuracy, quality, and alignment with client requirements. Create detailed instructor notes to complement training material. Conduct walkthroughs of the training content with clients and facilitators to secure approval. Utilize advanced authoring tools like Articulate and Captivate for creating learning materials. Integrate innovative tools and technologies to enhance content delivery and engagement. 3. Industry Trends and Technology Stay updated with industry trends and best practices in content development and training. Explore and implement new tools and technologies to improve content development processes and outcomes. Evaluate and adopt AI-enabled content creation and learning technologies to enhance productivity, learner engagement, and training effectiveness. Evaluate and adopt cutting-edge learning technologies and methodologies to enhance training effectiveness. 4. Mentorship and Team Development Mentor and provide guidance to junior content developers. Facilitate knowledge sharing and skill development within the team. Foster a collaborative and supportive team environment to promote continuous learning and improvement. 5. Internal Stakeholder Management Collaborate with internal stakeholders to get sign-off for the designed solutions. Communicate effectively with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment and support for content initiatives. 6. Process Improvement Track and analyze feedback on all content elements from internal teams, client stakeholders, and facilitators. Implement corrective measures based on feedback to improve content quality. Build and maintain a comprehensive content repository. Focus on process improvements and automation to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in content development. Identify opportunities to leverage AI-driven automation and reusable content assets to improve development speed, consistency, and scalability.

title: Senior Product Designer
jobDescription: About KNOLSKAPE At KNOLSKAPE, we are building the future of learning through immersive, simulation-based, AI-powered experiences. Our mission is to empower professionals and organizations with the skills they need to thrive in the age of transformation. We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer who is passionate about designing cutting-edge digital experiences that are intuitive, engaging, and impactful. Role Overview As a Senior Product Designer , you will be at the heart of shaping user experiences for KNOLSKAPE’s digital learning products. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams including Product Managers, Content Experts, Developers, and AI Engineers to craft intuitive interfaces, engaging interactions, and innovative design solutions. You are not only expected to deliver high-quality design work but also to actively leverage AI tools to enhance speed, scalability, and creativity. Key Responsibilities Take ownership of the full design process — from wireframes and prototypes to final UI. Work with Product Managers and teams to turn ideas and goals into user-friendly designs. Create user flows, storyboards, and mockups based on real-world scenarios. Design engaging simulations — including chat-based, branching, dashboard, and game-like formats. Ensure a consistent, accessible, and high-quality design across web and mobile platforms. Collaborate with developers to bring your designs to life accurately. Use AI tools (like Figma AI, UXPilot AI, Prototyping, ChatGPT, Midjourney, etc.) to speed up design and boost creativity. Build and maintain a design system that supports KNOLSKAPE’s learning products. Improve designs based on stakeholder feedback, user testing, and user behavior. Stay updated on design trends, AI tools, and innovations in experiential learning. Create product collaterals like decks, brochures, and one-pagers using PowerPoint, Google Slides, Adobe Suite, or Canva. Ensure fast and reliable delivery of design work — especially for urgent or client-facing tasks. What We’re Looking For 3+ years of experience as a Product Designer, UX/UI Designer, or in a similar role. Graduated from a design institute. A strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design thinking and visual design excellence. Proficiency in tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, Illustrator, After Effects (for motion design), or similar. Deep understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, and usability. Experience designing complex, content-heavy interfaces (LMS, dashboards, simulations, etc.) is a plus. Strong understanding of AI tools in the design workflow – and a passion for experimenting with and applying them for efficiency and creative augmentation. Ability to work independently and take ownership of design decisions, while also collaborating effectively within a team. Excellent communication skills – you can clearly articulate your design rationale and take feedback constructively. Good to Have Experience in EdTech, Gaming, B2B SaaS, or Simulation-based learning products. Basic understanding of HTML/CSS or design-to-code handoff processes. Familiarity with motion graphics or animations to enhance interactivity in learning products. Prior experience working in an Agile environment with tools like JIRA and Confluence. Why Join Us? Be part of a team shaping the future of experiential learning and AI-powered products. Get the freedom to experiment and innovate with cutting-edge AI design tools. Work in a fast-paced, impact-oriented environment where your ideas translate directly into global learning solutions. Collaborate with a passionate team of product leaders, instructional designers, and technologists.
